video_title: Steven Adams on LeBron James signing with Philadelphia, NBA career so far and giving back at home

quotes.speaker: Steven Adams
quotes.summary_phrase: Steven Adams on mentoring Jabari Smith Jr. and Alperen Sengun
quotes.excerpt: I just go the old school just bullying tactic. Just bully them. That's just fun.
quotes.quote: I just go the old school just bullying tactic. Just bully them. That's just fun. Especially the Turkish people, mate. Got to bully those guys. But no, it's been good, honestly, mentoring them and just seeing the growth. It is still exciting and just again, competing at that level and seeing the growth throughout the year, not just as an individual, but as a team.

quotes.speaker: Steven Adams
quotes.summary_phrase: Steven Adams on LeBron James' move to Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: I don't really care too much. Just because it doesn't necessarily matter in that sense.
quotes.quote: I don't really care too much. Just because it doesn't necessarily matter in that sense. Just because you have to just see how you are in the year. You have to come together. Even our team, we have to click, come together as a buy-in. New data comes out, do we have to change the play style? There's a lot of other variables. I mean, it's cool, but just for me, I'm just like, whoever's on the other team, cool. I have to worry about our team, how we're going to do.

quotes.speaker: Steven Adams
quotes.summary_phrase: Steven Adams on his future in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I'll play as long as I can. I just love it, the competition is so high.
quotes.quote: Whether it's in the league or not, I just like playing basketball, so wherever that is. I've been looking after my body as much as I can because I mainly do it just for after basketball, so I can still be functional and not move around too bad. I'll play as long as I can. I just love it, the competition is so high. You get such a rush, there's nothing like it. You get to really get immediate feedback if you're good enough to beat a team.
